project.name: my-browser-rust-chromium
project.description: Rust front (winit+wgpu) + Chromium (CEF, off-screen) backend. CEF renders the page to a texture; WE draw the whole chrome (tabs, URL bar, cloud login) in Rust. Clean Chrome fingerprint, zero Google UI.
project.frontend: rust (winit + wgpu) — OURS, no Chrome runtime UI

cef_rs.note: OSR = CEF renders web content to a wgpu texture in a Rust-owned winit window. NO Chrome chrome / no Google button — we composite our own front on top. cefsimple (Chrome runtime) was the wrong base; osr is the blank canvas we wanted.
